text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, out of the blue, Chairwoman 
Akikawa announces the "Summer Sprint 
Series."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If you achieve solid results across these 
three summer sprint races, something good 
might just happen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Hakodate Sprint Stakes in late June, 
the Keeneland Cup in late August, and the 
Centaur Stakes in early September.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While not mandatory, whether or not to 
participate in the race was something that 
seemed to require careful consideration.
